judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD test-writing phase and never implemented the actual production changes. While it updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and added failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` (along with an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file), `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and `CHANGELOG.md` are completely untouched. As a result, the new tests fail and the core bug—overwriting `lastUsage` instead of accumulating `totalUsage` across tool rounds—remains unfixed. Furthermore, the `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` signature was never updated to clarify that the usage represents the turn total.
